tasks.name: Coordinator hourly flow check
tasks.prompt: HOURLY FLOW CHECK (coordinator). Stop rule: each layer closes in under about 27.6 h from open. Answer "is it moving with urgency?" with numbers: the open layer, its jobs (working / complete / deferred), hours since open, lands in the last hour, and whether BOB lands and merges in dependency order. GITHUB BUDGET AND AUDIT (P27, PD-3): in a process3 worktree at the tranche run `node tool/p3.mjs github budget` and record the primary %, content-creating % and pushes/120 for the hour; if any is above 85% or a pause/stop is recorded, find which session drives it and slow it. Run `node tool/p3.mjs github audit --since <an hour ago>` and chase any unexplained push or write gap to its session. Push my own notes ONLY with `node <tranche worktree>/tool/p3.mjs github push origin start/coordinator-4nov`. Work the latest handoff's in-flight list (notes/coordinator-handoff-7nov-b.md and later notes). Check ROOT, BOB, the lanes and the builders are alive; nudge any idle while waiting on ci. Record a line in notes/coordinator-findings-3-4nov.md on start/coordinator-4nov and push (one push). Check your own context; hand over at 60%.
